title: Focusing Provider Attention: An Empirical Examination of Incentives and Feedback in Flu Vaccinations
authors: Robert J. Niewoehner; Bradley R. Staats
n_adoption_cohorts_note: Compliance Care program arms (Control, Ranking, Rebate) assigned for the 2018 flu season; arm x 2018 comparison against 2017 at a common date.
eligible_reason: Not staggered. Table 1: xtreg PctGrow Arm x 2018 with random effects (re), state dummies and patient count, a common-date arm-by-year comparison; Tables 2-3: within-season weekly clinic FE regressions on lagged rank (continuous) or lagged top/bottom-rank flags (time-varying, switching), not adoption; appendix Study 1 is a cross-sectional comparison. Data are under NDA with VaxCare; only a hypothetical one-clinic example is shipped.
design_notes: Stata 14. Clinic-level flu-shot panels (Aug-Dec seasons 2017-2018). Random-effects (REML-type xtreg, re) arm x year models; weekly FE models of doses per patient on lagged ranking feedback; placebo tests on rebate and control arms.

specs.exclusion_reason: common-date arm x year comparison; random effects instead of unit FE; multi-arm treatment
continuous lagged rank or lagged rank flags (time-varying treatment intensity, switches on/off), not staggered adoption

data_files_note: VaxCare shot records under NDA; the package ships only a hypothetical 44-row example for one clinic.
data_provenance_note: Single hypothetical clinic example (README: 'hypothetical example of 1 clinic's data'); analysis data not shipped.
screener_notes: Screened from package only (no article text or PDF). Common-date program evaluation; no data.
